show.description: Double Life of a Secret Billionaire is the passionate story of Shruti, a young woman forced into a marriage of compromise, and Yash Shetty, a mysterious man with a dark past. What begins as a deal soon turns into a journey of secrets, betrayal, and unexpected love, where fate keeps testing whether Shruti and Yash are bound by chance or destined forever. Watch Now!
